slides.title: Moyale clashes: Kenya sends more police
Kenya's police chief visits the border
slides.body: Inspector General Douglas Kanja ordered more officers to Moyale during a visit on Thursday, Nov 5, Nairobi News and KNA reported.

slides.title: people now affected, up from about 36,000
slides.body: Kenya Red Cross figure, counting displaced Ethiopians and Kenyan host communities. Food, shelter and medical aid are urgent.

slides.title: Stray bullets and power cuts in Kenyan Moyale
slides.body: A local leader said stray bullets forced some Kenyan families from their homes. The area relies on power from Ethiopia, now disrupted.

slides.title: Protect civilians. Reach host families with aid.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.
